rationale: Links configuration, pattern syntax, Shared expression evaluation and allocation. Describes unique-only consumption and transfer without hiding any new typing predicate. The public wrapper additionally links collection and initial-frame exit, distinguishing it from the local statement operation. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. Unpacking.Step evaluates the expression then applies Bind. Variable binding accepts either reference mode at a fresh variable; unpack requires an owned reference, declared class/field shape, exhaustive Transfer and fresh distinct destinations, then removes the container. Transfer preserves empty slots and reference values, matching the prose. Public transitions collect after local evaluation or pop an exhausted frame; these rules define the wrapper in place.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
